blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — The body of a fisherman was found floating along the Cagayan river in Barangay Sapping at the Cagayan town of Camalaniugan on Wednesday (November 11), the Philippine Coast Guard reported. The Coast Guard District North Eastern Luzon said in a statement that it retrieved the body of the 49-year-old fisherman, after a day of continuous search. The man was declared missing on November 10 after he was swept by strong river current and was believed to have drowned. His companion was able to swim to safety.
